narrative.overview: A personal project index, with technical headings and plain descriptions. Visible identity is **piducancore**. piducan.dev is the address. Avoid sales copy, claims of superiority, invented biography, and self-deprecation.
keyCharacteristics: Drafting monospace headings and labels with readable Archivo descriptions.
Uncropped UI screenshots reused from the child project sites.
Flat surfaces, fine separators, and explicit text actions.
Responsive reflow with visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: Actual work
rules.body: Use real UI screenshots, factual descriptions, and explicit links.

rules.name: Type hierarchy
rules.body: Use drafting monospace headings and labels with Archivo descriptions.

dos: Do keep the Graphite palette, technical headings and Archivo descriptions.
Do use actual project screenshots and factual project data.
Do distinguish interactive filters from passive metadata.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion and Light/Dark/System preferences.
donts: Don't invent biography, release availability, promotional claims or artwork.
Don't copy child-site release artifacts into the root deployment or change their routes.
Don't add decorative wave banners or temporary design selectors.
